profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Atlassian.  Check out what I'm up to at:

duynguyen.me

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

company.name: SASE - Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers

positions.title: President
positions.description:
- President of one of the largest professional development and social clubs at Virginia Tech with 140+ members (nearly a 100% gain in membership since my first year joining SASE 3 years ago)
- Collaborated and received sponsorships with multiple companies in the Engineering Space such as Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman to provide career building workshops and company highlights to assist students in their internship and full time job search
- Leading a team of 11 officers back into a fully in person year for the first time with full events and community gatherings
- Coordinated and planned 8 general body meetings throughout the year for 70 – 120+ in attendance and managed the mentor-mentee program to pair freshmen students with upperclassmen mentors to ease transition into life as a college student and receive professional advice (managed over 100 applicants to the program)

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
- Directly responsible for managing and creating all club meetings, club events, and programs such as the mentoring program to aid students in succeeding at Virginia Tech and promoting diversity in STEM 
- Won the Most Improved Chapter Nationally for SASE out of 84 chapters 
- Ran the mentorship program to match upperclassmen with underclassmen to aid high school to college transition with 100+ participants total

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Teacher Assistant for Data and Algorithm Analysis (CS 4104)
- Assist and aid students in understanding and applying algorithms and math concepts into code such as Dynamic Programming, Greedy Algorithms, N-Completeness, and more 
- Currently holding 8 hours worth of office hours a week to provide help in breaking down algorithms and assistance with homework

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- With a nationwide team, developed a decentralized peer-to-peer file management system using blockchain-based technology
- Created a React App that can upload and download files to IPFS (InterPlanetary File System), a decentralized and distributed file system that does not use any databases to store data
- Leveraged the blockchain with Hyperledger Fabric as a means to manage permissions and access to files within the file management system without the need of a system admin
- Collaborated with teams based in Virginia, Florida, and Colorado directly throughout the project
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · REST APIs · Hyperledger

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a web application tool for investigators to track/detect fraud in the healthcare system using Angular 
- Embedded the data visualization tools Neo4J and DataWalk for investigators to use and add a UI that makes the tools easy to use and requires no prior knowledge
- Investigated and used other data science tools such as Databricks and Dataiku to determine if their functionality would be beneficial to investigators
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · AngularJS · Angular · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed, with a team of 6 interns, a proof-of-concept web app that schedules, tracks, and reports successful and failed photos for an array of satellites 
- Designed a greedy algorithm which schedules photos for 480 satellites daily with outage management and bonusing features
- Simulated all 480 satellites using real time weather data from OpenWeather API to determine sensor availability 
- Presented bi-weekly presentations and demos to senior software engineers and executive leadership
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Node.js · React.js · AngularJS · Angular · REST APIs · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Cashier/Ice Cream Roller
positions.description: Maintained a high standard of customer service, worked on the line, responsible for opening and closing the store

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
- Served as a cashier and barista
- Further improved communication ability
- Worked on organization and leadership to juggle 5 methods of online delivery service while maintaining the highest quality for in store service

volunteerExperiences.description: • Tutored 3rd grade students at local elementary school to develop reading skills through personal mentor ship weekly after school
